notes.title: 2024-0908: New Demo !

tags.feature: Recently, in order to allow players to have more different experiences each time they play again, more content has been filled in the entire early game process; I want to make sure that every player's experience is as slightly different as possible;

Recently, a lot of new content has been added. If you develop a game by yourself, it always feels like you always have to add new interesting content and always have to add a lot of special bullets; It feels like there is no end to the development of a game; It's an interesting feeling;

tags.bug: As mentioned before, the game Angel at Dusk, I went to experience it; I found that the inside of the enemy will not be hurt, I found this design is very good; So I made some changes to the game, and now the game doesn't take damage when it bumps into enemies;

tags.feature: So in thinking about what can be done to change the relatively small update content, recently may prefer to update small content, and then see if you can update some more examples of mods in the creative Workshop (Workshop), so that players who may want to do mod more easily understand how to do mod;

notes.title: 2024-0901: Development log !

tags.feature: So, I added a lot of behavioral patterns to the BOSS, including a few difficult movement trajectories;

tags.balance_change: I also increased the melee damage a little bit;

tags.feature: Recently, the layout of the entire store page has been rearranged, and some new art materials have been updated; At the bottom is an image of a Brand Girl; I hope these new art materials can make people like;
so I added a hidden character to the game, which I can switch to by typing Konami Code while playing;

notes.title: 2024-0825: Development log !

tags.feature: Recently, some cute feedback behaviors have been added for the UI interface of the game running;
In this way, when obtaining some attribute items, the player can know the function of the item more clearly according to the feedback;

Recently, the overall internal structure of the game has been sorted out to a certain extent; This is to make it easier to update the game in the future; I've always felt that it's important to keep the game structure up to date;

Recently, I was thinking about the Creative Workshop. I tried my best to make mods as simple as possible. I also uploaded mods for demo, but I was worried that players could not learn them well. These can only be answered one by one after a player starts researching, and when a player starts asking;

I am very confident that the production of Mod will be very simple, but I am also afraid that the player will not learn at the beginning, this point can only be wait, hope that I can teach you how to make Mod in the future;

Since the game is about to be released on September 25th, I have been making detailed system optimization recently; Because it was the first game I made that was sold on Steam, I was worried about the stability of the game after it was actually released; Hope to be able to sell smoothly, no matter what, at the lowest level, also hope to be able to fix the problem of player feedback in the first time after the player feedback problem;

Recently, I have been thinking about the beautification of the store page, wondering whether I need to draw some pictures that can beautify the store page; This may take a while, but if you can draw it, the images on the store page should continue to update;

notes.title: 2024-0804: Development Log !

notes.title: 2024-0722: Development Log !
notes.content:
Q: Need an item description interface, when I play the game, I don't know which item has what effect;
A: OK, I'll think about how to include an easy-to-read description of the item.

Diary of the Week:
1. Hello, everyone. This time, we try to record the log once a day.
2. Recently, I am doing content filling work, and I want to make the content flow of the whole game as rich as possible.
3. Recently developed a new time trigger event, which can trigger events with higher performance when the target is close to another target; Wondering if it could be used in some interesting design;
4. I recently learned Vampire Survivors and wanted to make an off-site store. I thought that this off-site store would enhance the protagonist to a certain extent, which would be very interesting; At the same time, this may also reduce the difficulty of SHMUP/STG games to a certain extent, so that more players can play STG games happily.
5. It seems that the development of off-site stores can be successfully completed, and now I have a headache about how to design off-site stores; If you want to make the overall game much lower, I think you should add more enhancements to off-store stores; At present, I am still thinking about it, and I will see what kind of degree I can achieve by then.
6. Today, I posted in different forums to ask everyone what they think about this STG game, and got different levels of feedback; Now it's time to think about how this feedback can be applied to the game;
7. Today, I optimized the physics engine I wrote in the whole game. Maybe because of today's optimization, I can add a new bullet type to the game.
8. So, this week's journal is the previous ones, so we will see you next week ~

notes.title: 2024-0505: Demo_0.12 version has been updated!

tags.feature:
● New "Rewards Bar" :
○ Completion of the reward bar system, to obtain "reward items", will be listed in the "reward bar", players choose a item to obtain;

● New "Reward Enemies" :
○ Will appear in a fixed wave number, providing "bonus items" dropped enemies;

● New "Forest Fairy Dragon" :
○10-40 wave BOSS appears, as long as 10 seconds do not kill, there will be a "forest fairy dragon", with high health, as long as kill, will push the maximum number of waves in the game 10 waves, so that you can challenge 46-55 wave levels;
